headline: Base Turnover Spikes on Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the pattern of strategic‑base exchanges has sharpened. Fishermans Row now leads with forty‑one flips in the past day, up from thirty‑eight, the fighting still centred on Black Well, Fort Ember, Eidolo, Hangman’s Court and Oceanwatch; Colonial losses there are modest at seventy‑four while Warden casualties have risen to two‑hundred‑four and enlistments accelerate to two‑hundred‑eight per hour. Weathered Expanse holds at thirty‑seven flips, its butcher’s bill climbing to 13,285 Colonial and 16,469 Warden dead with 808 fresh enlistments per hour. Stlican Shelf eases to thirty flips, though casualties surge to 4,659 Colonial and 6,664 Warden and enlistments climb to 799. Linn Mercy records seventeen flips, driven by Lathair, with 3,680 Colonial and 6,528 Warden casualties and 905 enlistments. Mooring County drops to thirteen flips, yet sees 4,784 Colonial and 3,772 Warden losses and 1,033 enlistments. Godcrofts adds nine flips, modest casualties but enlistments rising to 116. Meanwhile the northern Warden‑held sectors and the quiet Colonial interiors such as Acrithia, Allods Bight and the far‑north remain static with negligible casualty change.
